text:
Separating what punishment is from why it is warranted keeps the description of an imposed hardship for an offense independent of any theory that defends it. Retributive, deterrent, and reformative arguments can then be tested against the same practice, so disagreement stays about reasons rather than about the meaning of the word. The aim of the institution can also be judged apart from the rules that decide who is punished and how much.

CONFIDENCE: 88
